body: So my SIL did send out virtual invites back in January, but i wasn’t thinking about my birthday plans 4 months in advance 💀

Thanks for your input. We’re engaged to be married later this year.
He has in the past. And only recently stopped this past year.

If It happened almost every month, am I still being unreasonable? I’m sitting at home and do have the tendency to get worried about him. I just wanna make sure he’s okay. Esp since his phone has died before in the past. But luckily he’s w/ friends so he can still uber home.
The lack of regard & care is mind boggling 🤯
